info.title: OSPF_Area
info.description: RESTful interface for AOS-CX switch software

area_id.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Area](#/OSPF_Area)
The list of all the "OSPF_Area" for the OSPF router instance, which contains the OSPFv2 area related configurations. The Area ID is in IPv4 address format.

area_type.description: This defines how the external routing and summary lsas for this area will be handled.

ipsec_ah.description: IPsec Authentication Header (AH) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), authentication type and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

spi.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). AH SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

ipsec_esp.description: IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), encryption/authentication type and key to use. IPsec Authentication Header (AH) is preferred over IPsec ESP if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

spi.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). ESP SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

lsa_counts.description: Specifies the lsa count for different types of LSA. router_lsa - Number of router link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database. network_lsa - Number of network link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database. network_summary_lsa - Number of Type-3 summary link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database. network_summary_asbr_lsa - Number of ASBR summary link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database. nssa_lsa - Number of Type-7 link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database. opaque_link_lsa - Number of Type-9 opaque link link-state advertisements (LSAs) in the link-state database.

ospf_interfaces.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Interface](#/OSPF_Interface)
The list of all the "OSPF_Interface" for the OSPF Area, which contains the OSPF interface related configurations, statuses, and statistics.

ospf_vlinks.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Vlink](#/OSPF_Vlink)
The list of all the "OSPF_Vlink" for the OSPF Area, which contains the OSPF Virtual link related configurations. The Peer Router ID is in IPv4 address format.

stub_default_cost.description: The cost metric for the default summary route sent into the stub area.

stub_metric_type.description: Configure the type of metric advertised as a default route.

abr_count.description: The number of Area Border Routers (ABR) in the area.

area_lsas_count.description: The total number of area scope LSAs.

area_lsas_sum_cksum.description: The sum of checksums of all area scope LSAs.

asbr_count.description: The number of autonomous system border routers (ASBR) in the area.

spf_calc.description: The number of times the SPF calculations has run.

parameters.name: VRF.name
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [VRF](#/VRF)
VRF identifier. Should be alphanumeric. VRF names must be unique.

parameters.name: OSPF_Router.instance_tag
parameters.description:
Reference Resource: [OSPF_Router](#/OSPF_Router)
The list of all the OSPFv2 Router instances.

parameters.name: attributes
parameters.description: Columns to display.

parameters.name: depth
parameters.description: Depth to traverse.

parameters.name: selector
parameters.description: Select configuration, status and/or statistics. Default is all categories.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filter rows by attribute values.  Format: attribute:value

parameters.name: count
parameters.description: Count the number of rows found.

parameters.name: If-None-Match
parameters.description: Entity-tag value for representation comparison (see RFC 7232 - Conditional Requests - section 3.2)

ipsec_ah.description: IPsec Authentication Header (AH) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), authentication type and key to use. IPsec AH is preferred over IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

spi.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). AH SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.

ipsec_esp.description: IPsec Encapsulating Security Payload (ESP) configuration. Specifies Security Parameters Index (SPI), encryption/authentication type and key to use. IPsec Authentication Header (AH) is preferred over IPsec ESP if both `ipsec_ah` and `ipsec_esp` are configured.

spi.description: Security Parameters Index (SPI) for the Security Association (SA). ESP SPI must be unique on a router because it is carried in IPsec protocol packet to enable the receiving system to select the SA to process the packet.
